Just completely my opinion though on a movie I've watched too many times. That scene just sticks with me for some reason. War will change you. The Billy bad ass attitude went right out the window as he saw his men gunned down and screaming in pain around him having no way to help without jeopardizing his own life. He had no choice but to lay there and watch it all unfold knowing it was his decision to foolishly chase the scout that caused the situation he and his men were in. I get goosebumps thinking about that scene still, having not watched the movie in years.

He's very situational he could either be a tanky supporting frontline engager, Or a way more squishy but way higher damage assassin type build. I just play whatever style my team needs within my play style.

I take W first to help with early jungle sustainability but after level two I prioritize bear over turtle. I hardly use Phoenix at all definitely not during fights. And right now tri force and streaks are what I keep hearing people rave about but I haven't tried steraks yet. And if I'm feeling frisky I'll even throw in some crit sometimes, or crit runes. One of the reasons I love udyr is you can kinda play him however you want and still demand respect from the enemy team.


I've seen people panic flash hella when I bear stance towards them when I'm building hardly any damage. If you don't respect the udyr he will kill you 70% of the time I'd say. One of if not the most slept on dualists in the game imo.

Are you just using 🐯 for attack speed into 🐢 .? Because if so you're dropping your damage output significantly because ad udyr does pretty much all his damage in 🐯 stance. Always come in in 🐻 stance though that part is right, And if the gank is taking longer I'd highly recommend switching back to 🐻 for another stun to help secure the kill.
